Worku Project

WORKU: Repositioning a B2B SaaS Platform

Worku is a Tunisian B2B SaaS platform that helps recruiters and sales teams find, filter, and contact the right profiles. It combines intelligent sourcing, advanced search, and contact enrichment in one place. I worked across the website, search visibility, analytics, and content to make the product clearer, more discoverable, and better aligned with how its two audiences actually use it. Here’s exactly what I executed:

Pillar 01 · SEO, GEO & Search Intent

SEO & Search Visibility Foundations

  • Audited 16 public-facing pages using a 30-criterion internal grid to identify missing SEO fundamentals.
  • Restructured H1, H2, and H3 hierarchies to match real B2B search intent and improve page readability.
  • Rewrote Title Tags and Meta Descriptions to improve click-through rates for targeted use-case pages.
  • Implemented contextual internal linking between the homepage, recruitment pages, and sales prospecting pages.
  • Conducted basic structured data (JSON-LD) and FAQ checks to prepare the content for GEO/AEO (AI-Search) visibility.
Pillar 02 · Analytics Tracking (GSC & GA4)

Data, Crawlability & Analytics

  • Strong Focus: Used Google Search Console daily to monitor sitemap discovery, indexed routes, and crawlability signals.
  • Investigated and documented technical indexation errors, including 404s, 5xx server errors, and 403 blocks during Googlebot automated tests.
  • Tracked the successful discovery of 14 key landing pages via XML sitemaps after site updates.
  • Junior Level: Used basic GA4 to monitor user traffic behavior, visibility trends, and page performance to inform marketing decisions.
Pillar 03 · B2B Content & LinkedIn Growth

B2B Content & Audience Growth

  • Conducted ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) and competitor research to differentiate the “Recruiter” audience from the “Sales/Commercial” audience.
  • Tested B2B targeting and lead-generation outreach angles based on the new sourcing positioning.
  • Created and published 9 targeted organic LinkedIn campaigns communicating product features and use cases.
  • Grew the LinkedIn community organically from 120 to 537 followers (+347%) during the project timeline.
UX/UI Transformation

Website & Product Experience

Redesigning how Worku presents its sourcing and prospecting product to two very different audiences: recruiters and sales teams.

01

Homepage restructure

Rebuilt the homepage to separate the recruiter journey from the sales prospecting journey. Clearer value proposition, stronger visual hierarchy, and audience-specific CTAs.

New homepage - one product, two clear paths for recruiters and sales teams.

02

Use-case landing pages

Created dedicated landing pages for recruitment and sales prospecting to match real search intent and better convert visitors from different sources.

Use-case pages - language and content matched to each visitor's intent.

03

Mobile experience

Corrected mobile hierarchy, spacing, and readability across key pages so Worku loads clearly on the devices most first-time visitors use.

Mobile hierarchy rework - readable CTAs stay above the fold.

Google Search Console diagnostics for Worku

01 / Technical Diagnostic

Why pages weren’t indexed

Isolating crawl errors, redirects, and indexation blockers

search.google.com/search-console
404 routes reviewedRedirect paths checkedServer errors documented

GSC Page Indexing diagnostic — used to identify why public or discovered URLs were blocked, redirected, missing, or not indexed.

  • Reviewed “Why pages aren’t indexed” signals in Google Search Console
  • Documented 404, redirect, and 5xx patterns affecting crawl quality
  • Separated true technical issues from expected non-indexable routes
  • Converted findings into prioritized cleanup and structure recommendations
  • Used this diagnostic as a baseline before broader SEO/content work
